messages:
From: Ravi Desai <ravi@sage-sys.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-30T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: quick pilot — PO?

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. We (Sage Systems) are excited to run a 6-week pilot integrating Redwood Inference into our analytics pipeline. Our finance ops typically invoices monthly and many of our early-stage vendors ask for net-30 invoices rather than an upfront PO. For this pilot we were hoping to invoice monthly without a formal PO on file — would Redwood allow a temporary no-PO invoice flow while we finalize vendor setup?

Attached: sage_vendor_intake.pdf (completed intake form) and a short pilot SOW.

Happy to provide W9 and references on request.

Best,
Ravi
Head of Partnerships
Sage Systems

Hi Ravi — thanks for the intake and SOW. Quick notes: Redwood's standard operating model requires a PO to route invoices to AP for payment. That said, for short pilots we sometimes approve a controlled exception with conditions (limited spend cap, single invoice per month, automated reminders, and a signed pilot SOW).

Marissa (cc'd) will need to approve the exception; can you confirm estimated monthly spend and billing address? Also please upload your W9 and bank details to the vendor portal link in my signature.

I'll prepare a short exception request once we have those details.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-12-02T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: quick pilot — PO?

Olga — I reviewed the intake and SOW. Estimated spend looks like ~$9,500/month for the pilot (per SOW). Finance policy prefers PO-backed invoices but we have an established short-term exception path for pilots under $10k/month with controls:
- Exception duration capped to 90 days
- Single monthly invoice, payment on receipt (net-15)
- Procurement to generate an exception memo and notify AP
- Vendor must complete vendor portal and provide W9 before first invoice

If Procurement creates the memo and obtains a manager approval (I can pre-approve on Finance side), AP will process invoices without a PO for the pilot. Need: final billing address, contact, and confirmation that Sage signs the attached pilot invoice terms (pilot_invoice_terms-v1.pdf).

Neha — FYI since this came up from your AE conversation. If Sage converts to a recurring paid account, we'll transition to standard PO flow.

Marissa
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Olga/Marissa — thanks, that plan works for us. Confirming: estimated monthly invoice ~USD 9,500, billing address is: 220 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105. We will sign the pilot invoice terms and push W9 and bank details into the portal today.

Two quick asks from our side: 1) can Redwood share the exception memo language so our procurement team knows the controls, and 2) will AP need a single point of contact for questions on invoices?

I've attached the signed SOW and a signed copy of the pilot invoice terms.

Best,
Ravi

Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: quick pilot — PO? (Approved exception memo)

Ravi — thanks for the quick turnaround and for uploading the W9. Per Finance we've approved a 90-day PO exception for Sage Systems' pilot under the following conditions (official memo below):

-- Exception memo (procurement):
Vendor: Sage Systems
Scope: 6-week pilot as described in SOW-sage-pilot.docx
Spend cap: $10,000/month
Duration: 90 days from first invoice date
Invoice cadence: single monthly invoice
Payment terms: net-15 from date of invoice
Controls: vendor must complete vendor portal; procurement will attach exception memo to invoice before sending to AP; any overage requires pre-approval.
AP contact for invoice questions: accounts-payable@redwood.ai

This memo is elevated to Finance and AP; Marissa has pre-approved on Finance's side. Procurement will attach this memo to the vendor record and notify AP when the first invoice lands.

Ravi — once you send the first invoice, please cc accounts-payable@redwood.ai and olga_petrov@redwood.ai so AP can route it under the exception. Welcome aboard — looking forward to the pilot.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
